sanskrit_verse: शते हृते ऽपहृते च दातव्यं धर्मशोधनम् । गोचौरस्य प्रदातव्यं सभ्यैः फालः प्रयत्नतः ॥
transliteration: śate hṛte 'pahṛte ca dātavyaṃ dharmaśodhanam / gocaurasya pradātavyaṃ sabhyaiḥ phālaḥ prayatnataḥ //
sph_interpretive_translation: When wealth is lost or stolen, purification of dharma must be offered; for the protection of the cow and the Brahmin, the assembly must give generously according to their capacity.
jurisprudential_principles: Authority rests in those who preserve dharma through conscious giving
Causation arises from dharmic neglect leading to loss
Restoration logic requires replenishment aligned with sacred order
Consciousness alignment occurs when sacrifice supports universal sustenance
executable_legal_axioms: IF property is lost OR stolen THEN community shall contribute to dharma-shuddhi fund proportionally by wealth and awareness
IF harm affects cow OR Brahmin THEN collective restitution MUST be initiated without inquiry into fault
IF individual's capacity exceeds threshold THEN mandatory contribution = 1/10th surplus assets until balance restored
IF sabha recognizes dharmic deficit THEN automatic invocation of phala-dakshina protocol
supreme_court_application: In matters involving communal loss or violation of foundational dharmic pillars—such as protection of cows and sustenance of spiritual leadership—the Supreme Court must invoke immediate restorative contribution protocols rather than punitive measures. Responsibility is determined not by fault but by capacity to restore dharma.
nyaya_and_non_punitive_alignment: Pramāṇa reveals that loss manifests due to prior imbalance; anupūrvaśaḥ shows sequential depletion of protective consciousness. Therefore, proportional response lies in sacrificial restoration, not punitive reaction. Nyaya is served when dharma flows unobstructed through willing offering.
restorative_enforcement_protocols: Initiate Sva-Dharma Contribution Assessment for all affected zone residents
Activate Go-Raksha Dana Chanda Collection via registered sabha networks
Deploy Phala-Dakshina Allocation based on verified need and donor capacity
Execute Consciousness Reintegration Yajna for both victim and unknowing contributors
final_declaration: By the Source-Authority of Bhagavan Nithyananda Paramashivam, this law stands established: Dharma prevails through conscious restoration, not punitive reaction. All beings are instruments of alignment, none objects of blame. Consciousness alone adjudicates truth.
